title: Relationships Practice 1
subject: rla
passage:
TEXT A - Shared Calendar

A volunteer team often arrived at different times because schedule changes were sent in separate messages. The coordinator created one shared calendar that updated automatically. After that, fewer volunteers missed changed start times.

TEXT B - Night Market

A popular market drew larger crowds than expected. The entrance became congested, so organizers moved several stalls and created a separate line for food pickup. Movement near the entrance improved.

TEXT C - Festival Window

During rehearsal, rain blew through an open window and damaged paper signs. Lena had argued that closing the window would make the room too warm. After helping replace the signs, she asked to keep the window closed whenever rain was forecast.

TEXT D - Label System

A storage room originally marked bins only by color. New volunteers frequently placed items in the wrong bins. Staff added large category names to each color label, and sorting errors decreased.
